items.name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
items.benefit: Health insurance coverage up to 5 lakh rupees per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation. Cashless and paperless treatment at empanelled hospitals across India.
items.eligibility: Families identified through the Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC) 2011 from deprived rural categories and eligible occupational categories. Eligibility is determined by the central government.
items.exclusions: Not all families are eligible. Eligibility is based on SECC 2011 data and specific deprivation criteria. Workers in some unorganised-sector categories may also qualify. Check the PM-JAY portal or nearest empanelled hospital to confirm eligibility — this must be verified.
documents: Aadhaar card or acceptable photo ID
PM-JAY card issued at empanelled hospital or Common Service Centre
application_steps: Check eligibility at pmjay.gov.in or visit nearest empanelled hospital
If eligible, a PM-JAY card is issued at the empanelled hospital or Common Service Centre
Present the PM-JAY card and ID at any empanelled hospital for cashless treatment
items.source_title: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Official Portal, Government of India

items.name: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS)
items.benefit: State government health insurance for eligible Tamil Nadu families. Covers specified treatments at empanelled hospitals in Tamil Nadu. Designed to supplement central schemes like PM-JAY.
items.eligibility: Tamil Nadu residents meeting the scheme's income and eligibility criteria. The eligibility threshold and covered treatments may change — verify with the official portal.
items.exclusions: Coverage details, eligibility thresholds, and the list of empanelled hospitals should be verified with the official CMCHIS portal as they are updated periodically. This must be verified.
documents: Aadhaar card or acceptable photo ID
application_steps: Check eligibility and coverage at the CMCHIS portal or nearest empanelled hospital
Enrol at an empanelled hospital with ID and residence proof
Use the scheme card at empanelled hospitals for cashless treatment

items.name: Dr. Muthulakshmi Reddy Maternity Benefit Scheme
items.benefit: Financial assistance for pregnant women in Tamil Nadu to support maternal and child health during pregnancy and delivery. Aims to reduce maternal and infant mortality.
items.eligibility: Pregnant women in Tamil Nadu meeting the scheme's income and residency criteria. Specific eligibility requirements and assistance amounts should be verified with the local health office or official Tamil Nadu government portal.
items.exclusions: Exact assistance amount and eligibility criteria may change. Verify with the official Tamil Nadu government portal or the local Primary Health Centre. This must be verified.
documents: Aadhaar card or acceptable photo ID
Mother and Child Protection Card or pregnancy record
application_steps: Visit the local Primary Health Centre or government hospital with ID and pregnancy records
Health staff will verify eligibility and enrol the beneficiary
Financial assistance is provided as per the scheme guidelines

items.name: KIRAN Mental Health Helpline
items.benefit: 24/7 toll-free mental health support helpline for people facing emotional distress, anxiety, depression, or suicidal thoughts. Staffed by trained counsellors. Phone number: 1800-599-0199.
items.eligibility: Anyone in emotional distress or needing mental health support can call. No eligibility criteria. The helpline is free and available across India.
items.exclusions: The helpline provides initial support and referral, not ongoing treatment. For ongoing mental health care, consult a qualified mental health professional. This is not a substitute for emergency services.
documents: No documents needed to call the helpline
application_steps: Call 1800-599-0199 (toll-free, available 24/7)
Speak with a trained counsellor about your situation
Follow the counsellor's referral for further help if needed

items.name: Tele-MANAS Mental Health Helpline
items.benefit: National mental health teleconsultation service providing free mental health support via phone. Connects callers with trained mental health professionals. Phone numbers: 14416 or 1800-891-4416.
items.eligibility: Anyone seeking mental health support can call. No eligibility criteria. The service is free and available across India.
items.exclusions: Tele-MANAS provides teleconsultation and referral, not emergency services or ongoing in-person treatment. For emergencies, call 108. For ongoing care, consult a qualified mental health professional. This must be verified.
documents: No documents needed to call the helpline
application_steps: Call 14416 or 1800-891-4416 (toll-free)
Speak with a mental health professional
Follow the referral for further care if needed

items.name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
items.benefit: Central online portal for multiple government scholarships for students from SC, ST, OBC, EBC, and minority categories. Covers pre-matric, post-matric, merit-cum-means, and other scholarships. Single portal for application and tracking.
items.eligibility: Students from eligible categories (SC, ST, OBC, EBC, minority) meeting specific income and academic criteria for each scholarship. Each scholarship has its own eligibility requirements listed on the portal.
items.exclusions: Each scholarship has specific eligibility criteria, income limits, and deadlines that change yearly. Check the NSP portal for current details. Application deadlines must be verified each year.
documents: Bank account details (in the student's name for some schemes)
application_steps: Register and apply at scholarships.gov.in
Upload required documents
Submit the application before the deadline
Track application status on the portal

items.name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
items.benefit: Scholarship for Scheduled Caste students studying in classes IX and X to reduce dropout rates and support their education. Provides financial assistance for education-related expenses.
items.eligibility: SC students in classes IX-X whose parents' or guardians' annual income does not exceed the scheme's income limit (verify the current limit on the NSP portal). The student must be attending a recognised school.
items.exclusions: Income limit and scholarship amount may change yearly. Only for SC category students in classes IX and X. Verify current details on the NSP portal. This must be verified.
application_steps: Apply through the National Scholarship Portal at scholarships.gov.in
Upload caste certificate, income certificate, and school records
Submit before the deadline
Track status on the portal

items.name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
items.benefit: Scholarship for Scheduled Caste students pursuing post-matriculation studies (class XI and above, including higher education, technical and professional courses). Covers tuition, maintenance, and other education-related expenses.
items.eligibility: SC students who have passed class X (matriculation) and are pursuing higher studies, whose parents' or guardians' annual income does not exceed the scheme's income limit (verify the current limit on the NSP portal).
items.exclusions: Income limit and scholarship amount vary by course level and may change yearly. Only for SC category students. Verify current details on the NSP portal. This must be verified.
application_steps: Apply through the National Scholarship Portal at scholarships.gov.in
Upload caste certificate, income certificate, and academic records
Submit before the deadline
Track status on the portal

items.name: Tamil Nadu Free Bus Pass Scheme for Students
items.benefit: Free bus travel for eligible students in Tamil Nadu on government buses. Aims to reduce the cost of education by providing free transportation to and from school or college.
items.eligibility: Students studying in Tamil Nadu government, aided, and recognised private schools and colleges. The student must be enrolled in a recognised institution and meet the scheme's criteria.
items.exclusions: Eligibility criteria, stage limits, and the specific routes covered may vary. Verify with the school or college administration and the Tamil Nadu government transport department. This must be verified.
documents: Aadhaar card or acceptable photo ID
application_steps: Obtain a bonafide certificate from the school or college
Apply for the bus pass at the school office or designated transport office
Collect the bus pass and use it on government buses

items.name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
items.benefit: Monthly pension for eligible persons with severe disabilities. Part of the National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP). Aims to provide financial support to persons with disabilities from below-poverty-line families.
items.eligibility: Persons with severe (80% or more) multiple disabilities aged 18-79 from below-poverty-line (BPL) families. The disability must be certified by a medical board. Specific eligibility criteria should be verified.
items.exclusions: Disability percentage, age limits, and pension amount may change. Only for BPL families with severe disabilities. Verify current details with the NSAP portal or local revenue office. This must be verified.
documents: Disability certificate from a medical board
application_steps: Obtain a disability certificate from a government medical board
Apply at the local revenue office or through the NSAP portal
Submit BPL certificate, disability certificate, and ID documents
Pension is credited to the bank account upon approval
